Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to feature a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Today, a new leak has detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model.

Here is the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

With the innovative iPhone Ultra launch imminent, it is Apple's first foldable model ever. But next year will bring another unique new iPhone design.

Rumors suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. According to reports, the new device will feature a larger screen with a quad-curved display that extends to the edges of the body, creating a visually borderless effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital today updated Apple's progress in achieving this unique look in a new article.

He said the glass assembly process used by the company is the same as that used for the iPhone Air. However, modifications have been made to accommodate more rounded materials.

The article also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Heat dissipation
  • Slimness

It is still too early to determine what specifications Apple wants to achieve in terms of thickness and design materials. However, signs so far indicate that this new model will draw inspiration from both the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritize slimness to the same extent.

Based on these latest updates, we are very likely to see a model that combines some of the design innovations of both the iPhone Air and Ultra, while still delivering the performance and battery life that Pro users expect.

Pro users do not want slimness to be a priority. But if Apple can deliver a comparable experience in a moderately thinner model, with a unique all-glass look, that would be very appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumored iPhone Pro 20 model? Let us know in the comments.
